What is cursor-bin?

Cursor is a full desktop coding environment, forked from VS Code, that puts AI agents at the center of the workflow. It lets you pick from multiple frontier models to generate code, run autonomous cloud agents that build and test features in the background, and review pull requests or trigger automations straight from the editor, terminal, or Slack. It's aimed at developers who want an IDE where an AI agent can take on real chunks of implementation work, not just autocomplete.

Install cursor-bin on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add cursor-bin

Good to know

  • A Cursor account
  • Network access
  • A paid plan (Pro or higher) for meaningful agent usage beyond the free tier's limits
